title: Instant-NGP
paper_title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding
core_mech: Instant-NGP 的速度来自可学习多分辨率 hash-grid encoding 和空空间跳跃，而不是更深的 NeRF MLP。
core_mech_en: Replaces fixed sinusoidal positional encodings with a multi-resolution hierarchy of learnable hash tables paired with a tiny fused-CUDA MLP, accelerating neural fields by 100×–1000×.
input_desc: 3D 坐标、观察方向及训练相机射线
input_en: Continuous 3D coordinate x ∈ R³ mapped across L resolution grids via spatial hashing
output_desc: 快速优化的 density/color 场与实时新视角渲染
output_en: Concatenated L×F interpolated feature vector decoded in microseconds into density/attenuation/SDF

adapter.name: Instant-NGP
adapter.mechanism: Learnable multiresolution hash tables interpolate features at eight cell corners before a small radiance decoder.
limitations: CPU PyTorch implementation; no fused CUDA kernels, occupancy skipping or claimed real-time performance.
